baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنزَلْنَاهُ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ ... يَهْدِي مَن يُرِيدُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberately delivered object arrives as visible markers; their disclosure supplies gentle orientation, while divine intention governs whom that orientation reaches.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and conveyance make descent the first operation in the disclosure-to-guidance chain.
A visible marker gives the delivered material a perceptible sign-function.
Appearance and disclosure make the markers available rather than hidden.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth converts disclosure into orientation.
Will and intention govern the personal reach of the orienting act.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports that a revelation is clear and that God guides selectively.
changed_reading.after: The clauses form a functional chain: delivery becomes visible disclosure, disclosure becomes direction, and intention governs uptake.

baseline_models.mechanism: Proper placement, distinct markers, and a named direction combine into an articulated route: the signs are separately legible waypoints rather than an undifferentiated proof mass.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its fitting station supplies ordered placement.
The visible mark functions as a waypoint.
Separation keeps one marker distinguishable from the next.
Direction, manner, and intended course turn the placed marks into a route.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs are a collection of propositions or proofs.
changed_reading.after: Clear signs are deliberately placed and differentiated waypoints whose ordered relation makes guidance navigable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated water descents turn dormant ground into moving, growing, green ground. This activates a receptive-material model in which sent signs do not only inform; they enter a recipient and make latent life perceptible, while guidance names the gentle direction of that response.

activation_trace.role: Conveyed descent anchors the focus clause to a delivered input.
A visible marker lets the recipient's changed state itself register as a sign.
Gentle direction supplies the human-side analogue to nonviolent, life-bearing rain.
The same delivered descent is materially realized as water reaching dead-looking earth.
Conveying water by watering or pouring supplies the medium that enters the recipient.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first observable response.
Vegetation emerging from earth completes the latent-to-visible transformation.
A second water descent makes the ecological mechanism recurrent rather than incidental.
Fresh green growth is the visible disclosure produced by descent.
Gentleness and beneficence sharpen the manner shared with the focus guidance branch.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders descent, contact with dormant earth, movement, swelling, and growth as a causal sequence.
22:63 repeats descent-to-greening and closes the sequence with divine gentleness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two water-to-life event chains and a gentle-guidance branch; I infer that human reception can follow the same input-to-activation shape. Alternatively, the ecological scenes may illustrate divine power without specifying how 22:16 guides.

changed_reading.before: Sent signs are clear informational objects delivered to a passive hearer.
changed_reading.after: Sent signs are life-bearing inputs whose clarity appears as an activated response in receptive ground; guidance is germinative as well as informative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding upward extension, rope/link, severance, and inspection reverse into downward delivery, visible marks, and direction. The focus signs become an articulated received line answering a self-made line that can be cut.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the downward half of the directional reversal.
Visible marks articulate the received line into inspectable points.
Direction gives the descended line an orienting course.
Drawing something out until it connects supplies the upward extension.
A rope or connecting link supplies a severable access line.
Cutting a connection supplies the failure mode that the received line answers.
Directed sight or insight makes the preceding construction an explicit test of what it accomplishes.

structural_cues: 22:15 places extension toward the sky, a link, cutting, and inspection immediately before 22:16's descent and guidance.
The opening وَكَذَٰلِكَ makes the directional reversal locally salient without by itself fixing the syntactic relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upward link that is cut, followed by descent, signs, and direction; I infer a reversal from self-made severable access to received orientation. Alternatively, 22:15 may provide only the rhetorical occasion rather than a spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The signs are independently placed waypoints.
changed_reading.after: The signs are points on a descended orienting line, answering an upward connection whose cutting cannot produce the desired change.

context_deltas.mechanism: A public call brings dispersed bodies through distant passes toward a sacred center, where ritual markers, repeated practice, and straight alignment coordinate them. Guidance therefore acquires a choreographic and communal dimension: signs organize convergent movement, not only private cognition.

activation_trace.role: Visible markers anchor the focus signs as public orientation points.
Direction and course let those markers coordinate movement.
Purposeful approach toward what is magnified supplies the convergent destination.
A broad pass between mountains supplies the many traversable routes into one approach.
A sign that is also a ritual marker makes the sign-function bodily and public.
The place and performance of a rite turn orientation into enacted practice.
Alignment on a straight line supplies visible coordinated ordering.
The repeated guidance root explicitly names direction within the ritual sequence.
Persistence on a way makes each community's rite an ongoing route rather than an isolated act.
Straight guidance closes the rite-and-route sequence with explicit orientation.

structural_cues: 22:27 begins with a public summons and depicts arrival from every distant pass.
22:32-37 moves through ritual signs, aligned bodies, and an explicit reference to guidance.
22:67 again places ritual practice beside straight guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, converging roads, ritual markers, alignment, repeated practice, and guidance; I infer that 22:16's signs can coordinate a community's movement. Alternatively, these rites may exemplify guidance without defining its general mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an inward understanding granted to separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also choreographs dispersed people into a shared course through public markers, repeated practices, and a common destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Uncontrolled fall from the sky ends in dispersal and remoteness, whereas the sky is elsewhere held from falling except by permission. Against those alternatives, the focus descent reads as a regulated landing into a fitting station, and guidance as preservation of destination.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper station supplies controlled arrival rather than mere downward motion.
Direction and intended course preserve a destination through the descent.
Falling into an abyss supplies the uncontrolled counter-image to settled descent.
Wind and moving air supply lateral dispersal after the fall.
Distance and removal name the lost destination produced by uncontrolled motion.
Holding and restraining supply active regulation of the sky-ground relation.
Falling and then becoming fixed expose both danger and possible settled arrival.
Permission makes descent governed rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 22:31 opposes stable orientation with fall from the sky, wind-borne displacement, and a remote terminus.
22:65 pairs commanded travel with restraint of the sky and permits falling only under authorization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncontrolled dispersal and restrained, authorized falling; I infer that the focus descent is calibrated to arrive and remain useful. Alternatively, the fall scenes may be moral contrasts rather than a specification of revelation's delivery.

changed_reading.before: Sending down identifies only the source and vertical movement of the signs.
changed_reading.after: Sending down is a managed landing that preserves placement and destination against seizure, drift, and remote loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material ruins become legible only through travel, hearing, and heart-level reasoning; the packet then relocates blindness from eyes to hearts. Clear signs are therefore encountered stations that train perception, and guidance includes moving a reader through evidence until it becomes inwardly intelligible.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker anchors the focus to things that can be encountered and read.
Disclosure names the successful outcome of the perceptual itinerary.
A course or way makes movement through evidence part of guidance.
Collapse and ruin supply a material trace waiting to be read.
Going and flowing through the land make encounter with the trace an active itinerary.
Intellect that restrains ignorance converts encountered traces into judgment.
Understanding and responsive hearing add an aural path to disclosure.
Heart-blindness locates failure in reception rather than in the visibility of the trace.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the explicitly insufficient outer layer of seeing.

structural_cues: 22:45 presents ruined settlements, an abandoned well, and a raised structure as surviving material traces.
22:46 immediately commands travel and coordinates hearts that reason, ears that hear, eyes that see, and hearts that can remain blind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material remains followed by travel and layered perception; I infer an itinerary by which signs become inwardly clear. Alternatively, the travel command may be a particular admonition rather than a general account of 22:16's signs.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs are self-interpreting objects that only need to be presented.
changed_reading.after: Clear signs are encountered traces whose disclosure requires guided movement, hearing, and heart-level reasoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs pass through interference, removal, and confirmation; the resulting trial separates diseased or hardened reception from knowing, believing, humbled reception. Later recitation makes rejection recognizable on faces. Thus clarity is not merely a static property: it is an active differentiator that both survives contamination and exposes the receiver.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the sorting operation latent in 'clear signs.'
Disclosure supplies the visible result of that sorting.
Guidance names one receiver-side outcome rather than a quality forced uniformly on all.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the filtering stage.
Making firm, exact, and secure supplies stabilization after interference.
The same visible-marker branch identifies what is stabilized.
Testing metal or persons supplies the assay that separates responses.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the knowing receiver's recognition mechanism.
Gentle direction explicitly closes the successful branch of the assay.
The repeated clear-sign construction activates disclosure during public recitation.
Recognition and distinction by a trace make the hearer's response outwardly diagnostic.
The contrary of recognition supplies the negative state that becomes visible.

structural_cues: 22:52-54 orders alien insertion, removal, confirmation of signs, testing of hearts, recognition of truth, humbled belief, and guidance.
22:72 orders recitation of clear signs, recognition of rejection in faces, and near physical aggression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies filtering and stabilization of signs plus visibly divergent receiver states; I infer that بَيِّنَات names an enacted differentiation as well as semantic clarity. Alternatively, these sequences may describe consequences of already-clear signs rather than the mechanism of their clarity.

changed_reading.before: The signs are clear because their content is intrinsically obvious.
changed_reading.after: The signs are clarifying agents: they survive filtering, separate responses, and make the receiver's hidden condition perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later divine choosing selects messengers and draws a community near for a witnessing role. This sharpens 'whom He wills' into purposeful commissioning: guidance can select, prepare, and position a person to carry signs onward, not only grant private understanding.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention anchor the focus clause's selective agency.
A guide who advances at the front makes guided selection capable of producing a role-bearer.
Choosing a select portion supplies explicit purposive selection.
Messenger and message specify the communicative office assigned by selection.
Choosing and drawing near supply preparation and positioning, not arbitrary preference alone.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the role toward which the selected are positioned.

structural_cues: 22:75 grammatically assigns the choosing of messengers to God.
22:78 links divine choosing with the messenger's witness-role and the community's witness-role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine selection followed by communicative and witnessing offices; I infer that willing-guidance can commission its recipient for transmission. Alternatively, 22:16's scope may remain broader than the vocational selections near the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: God's willing determines who privately receives direction.
changed_reading.after: God's willing can guide by selecting and positioning recipients to become carriers and witnesses of the delivered signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د mapping, so it is deliberately form-distant. It remains anchored in يَهْدِي and is made locally live by shaking and collapsed structures across the surah, but downstream prose must present it only as a functional overlay in which guidance dismantles false supports, never as a lexical translation of يَهْدِي as 'destroy.'

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition make a deconstructive phase available inside the packet's split mapping.
Separation gives the breaking a focus-anchored result: formerly joined structures become distinguishable.
Shaking and disturbance activate destabilization at the surah's opening.
Bringing down a building supplies an explicit demolition image close to the split root.
Collapse and ruin show the exposed aftermath from which a changed orientation can begin.

changed_reading.before: Guidance adds a route while leaving the recipient's existing structures intact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance may begin by breaking false supports so that clear distinctions and a new route can appear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the sacrificial-offering branch of ه د ي around verbal guidance. It remains anchored in the focus root and is strongly pressured by the local sequence of sacrifice, ritual markers, and هَدَىٰكُمْ, but downstream prose must call it an associative ritual overlay and must not replace the verbal sense 'guides' with the noun 'offering.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَهْدِي and the ه د ي offering branch

activation_trace.role: An offering conveyed to the sanctuary recasts guidance as dedicated movement toward a sacred destination.
Conveyance supplies the transfer component that lets the offering image modify guidance.
A sacrificial offering makes the cross-domain ه د ي branch locally concrete.
A ritual marker binds signhood to the sacrificial scene.
The guidance surface inside the sacrifice sequence reactivates the offering branch without erasing its verbal sense.

changed_reading.before: Guidance directs a recipient toward a path.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance also conveys and dedicates the recipient toward a sacred end, as though orientation were a consecrated transfer.

strongest_changes: Descent became a regulated, life-bearing arrival rather than simple vertical transmission.
Clear signs became active discriminators that survive interference and expose the receiver's condition.
Guidance became an embodied and communal routing through roads, rites, material traces, and assigned witness-roles.
The immediate severed-link sequence made the focus descent readable as received orientation arriving from the opposite direction.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted the focus's compact spatial vocabulary into mechanisms: rope and severance, rain and germination, fall and restraint, pilgrimage and alignment, ruins and heart-perception, then filtering and public reaction. The split mappings also preserved two contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from juxtaposed scenes back into 22:16 are reader-supplied; some may be rhetorical echoes rather than mechanisms.
The ritual-offering activation of ه د ي is locally strong but remains an associative overlay, not a lexical substitution.
Purposeful commissioning sharpens divine willing but does not exhaust the broader scope of مَن يُرِيدُ.
The ه د د outlier depends on a form-distant mapped root and should remain explicitly exploratory.
